items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I went with Machito. I worked with Machito for awhile... I stayed with Machito -- went to Japan with Machito. I stayed with him, recorded with him quite a long time after that.

ctx.x: And I worked Martinique, as a substitute with the band. They liked me and I found it interesting, of course everything was reading and it was a a -- challenge. Quite different from reading American scores. So I stayed with them quite awhile. They broke up and then I went with Machito.
